mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_consult_session (appointment_id, student_id, counselor_id, status, start_time) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{studentId}, #{counselorId}, #{status}, #{startTime})

INSERT INTO cs_consult_record (session_id, student_id, counselor_id, chief_complaint, consult_process, assessment, suggestion, archive_status) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{studentId}, #{counselorId}, #{chiefComplaint}, #{consultProcess}, #{assessment}, #{suggestion}, #{archiveStatus})
mapper.select: select session_id from cs_consult_session where appointment_id = #{appointmentId} and counselor_id = #{counselorId}
mapper.update: update cs_appointment set status = #{status} where appointment_id = #{appointmentId}
update cs_consult_session set status = #{status} where session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT csr.*, su.real_name AS studentName, suc.real_name AS counselorName FROM cs_consult_record csr LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON csr.student_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user suc ON csr.counselor_id = suc.user_id WHERE csr.record_id = #{recordId}
